# FFmpeg binary and source directions

The full video edition uses the unmodified `ffmpeg.exe` from Gyan Doshi's
FFmpeg 8.1.1 essentials build as a separate command-line process. The application
does not link against FFmpeg libraries.

- [Original binary release and upstream source declaration](https://github.com/GyanD/codexffmpeg/releases/tag/8.1.1).
- Original ZIP: `ffmpeg-8.1.1-essentials_build.zip`.
- Original ZIP SHA256: `6f58ce889f59c311410f7d2b18895b33c03456463486f3b1ebc93d97a0f54541`.
- License: GNU GPL version 3. The original text is retained in `LICENSE`.
- Exact FFmpeg source commit: `239f2c733de417201d7ad3b3b8b0d9b63285b2b1`.
- [Browse exact upstream source](https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg/tree/239f2c733de417201d7ad3b3b8b0d9b63285b2b1).
- [Download exact upstream source archive](https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg/archive/239f2c733de417201d7ad3b3b8b0d9b63285b2b1.tar.gz).
- [Release copy of the exact FFmpeg source archive](https://github.com/noah-ad/astral-party-mod-maker/releases/download/v2.3.6/FFmpeg-8.1.1-source-239f2c733d.tar.gz).

The adjacent original `README.txt` contains the upstream build configuration,
enabled codecs, filters and external libraries. Consult the
[original build provider](https://www.gyan.dev/ffmpeg/builds/) for the complete
build environment and external dependencies; the FFmpeg source archive is not a
source archive for all of those third-party libraries. Their original terms
continue to apply. No FFmpeg source changes were made for this application.
